review_description: Got a good deal included smart meter.Fast and quality instalation.jameas himself came and installed the system.In two years already got 3/4 cost back.

James provided a thorough and informative quote and the communication leading up to the job was excellent. The price was bang on! Chris and Jesse arrived spot on time, their work was efficient, professional and tidy. Highly recommend Taylor Energy and looking forward to lower electricity bills!

I was grateful for the extra quotes accessed through solarquotes.com.au - it saved me a lot of time trying to find a appropriate solar suppliers to quote.  Everyone responded quickly but it was a mixed bag of results - some followed through with what they said, others didn't and in the end it was quite difficult to get anyone to call me back when I requested more information.It was quite disconcerting that almost everybody had something different to recommend for our organisation - comparing quotes was a bit like comparing apples with oranges!Overall, I've found the solarquotes website and service very helpful but organising solar is definitely not a straightforward proposition!!
